shots.title: Y01 · Two-factor setup
shots.caption: Two-factor authentication: open Account → Security and "Set up two-factor authentication". Scan the QR code with any TOTP app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password) or type the secret, then enter the six digits the app shows and confirm. From then on every password sign-in asks for a code. Admins can remove a lost second factor from Operations.

shots.title: Y02 · Second factor at sign-in
shots.caption: Signing in with a second factor: after the password the page asks for the authenticator code. The server only issues a session cookie once the code checks out; five wrong codes void the challenge and you start again. SSO accounts sign in through the identity provider button instead.

shots.title: Y03 · Single sign-on
shots.caption: Single sign-on: with OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_CLIENT_ID (and optionally a client secret) set on the server, the login page offers the identity provider. The flow is authorization code with PKCE; the id_token is verified against the provider's JWKS (RS256, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce). First sign-in creates the account with OIDC_DEFAULT_ROLE; OIDC_ADMINS become admins; OIDC_ALLOWED_DOMAINS restricts who may enter.
marks: Sign in through the identity provider

shots.title: Y04 · Operations
shots.caption: Operations (admins, Account → Operations): write a backup now and see the last ones; run the retention purge for the wastebasket; set or release legal holds per case; look up and download everything the cases hold about a named person; remove a lost second factor.
marks: Legal hold set on this case

shots.title: Y05 · Legal hold
shots.caption: A held case carries a LEGAL HOLD stamp on its folder. Delete is refused on the desk and on the board, the server ignores delete requests for it, and retention never purges it. The hold and its release are logged on the case and in the audit trail.

shots.title: Y06 · Personal data export
shots.caption: Subject access: type a person's name; the server collects their person cards, comments by or about them, tasks assigned to them and log lines that name them, across every case. Download the JSON to answer an access or erasure request. Every lookup is written to the audit trail.

shots.title: Y07 · Users panel
shots.caption: The Users panel now shows who has a second factor and who signs in through SSO. Admins reset passwords here and remove a lost second factor from Operations; SSO-only accounts have no password to reset.
